patch_description:
This implementation replaces independent shortest paths with a directed Steiner-tree approach. For small destination sets, it uses an exact subset dynamic program that finds a minimum-cost shared broadcast arborescence rooted at the source. Shared relay links are paid for once and reused by every destination, substantially reducing redundant inter-cloud transfers.

For larger destination sets, it falls back to a marginal-cost multicast heuristic that repeatedly attaches the destination requiring the least additional network cost to the existing broadcast tree. All resulting shared tree paths are expanded into the existing `BroadCastTopology` interface for every partition.
